content: Agentic lookup best practice: curated, bounded, read-only CLI toolset. ripgrep (rg) is the search backbone for coding agents (aider etc): one command, one block of text output, concatenable into prompt; skips binary, respects .gitignore, structured output -> cleaner context, fewer tokens. Fewer well-defined tools beat unlimited options. Read-only nature makes tools safe/predictable in an agent loop (issue command, read stdout, decide next step). Context processing dominates cost in extended workflows, so clean upstream search cuts tokens/latency/cost. Keep toolset well-known and explicitly enumerated.
